usage.purpose: Defines the controlled dictionary of applicant group identifiers used throughout Apply Smart.
rules: Applicant groups are not mutually exclusive.
An applicant may belong to multiple groups simultaneously.
Every applicant group referenced by a university JSON must exist in this file.
This file defines identifiers only; university JSON files define the admissions rules associated with each applicant group.
